items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 10:1
items.html: Phase Four, Phase Three, and Phase Two — which are the three levels of Galgalta, AB, and SAG — came out in AK. Phase One, which is the level of ZA, came out in Nekudim. And the phase of the coarseness of Keter came out in Atzilut, which is the level of Malchut, called BON. However, since there is there the aspect of the record of Phase One of clothing, which is the level of ZA, Atzilut, too, is therefore also called by the name MA. (Inner Observation, item 2) (Note by our master the author: but in order to distinguish it from the MA of AK, which is the Nekudim, it is called the new MA.)
